taxonomy_notes.client_type: federal_navfac is the correct sub-entry under federal. NAVFAC Mid-Atlantic is the contracting/issuing authority.
taxonomy_notes.program_type: Building 3855E is warehouse-to-gym/training space conversion on a military installation. Closest vocab entries: military_training (training facility) and military_dining_morale (MWR). military_training is primary; military_dining_morale included as the gym/MWR function.
taxonomy_notes.delivery_method: RFP title explicitly states '8(a) DESIGN-BUILD/DESIGN-BID-BUILD' — design-build is the primary delivery method specified in the contract vehicle title. The task order could be awarded as either; design-build is listed first and is more common for this MACC type.
taxonomy_notes.contract_vehicle: Parent vehicle is an 8(a) MACC (IDIQ). This RFP is for a proposed task order under that MACC. Both federal_macc and federal_task_order apply.
taxonomy_notes.procurement_type: 8(a) set-aside is explicit in the MACC title: '8(a) DESIGN-BUILD/DESIGN-BID-BUILD'.
taxonomy_notes.award_type: Award basis is explicitly lowest price: 'In accordance with FAR Part 15, low price process is selected as appropriate for this procurement and award shall be made to the lowest-priced responsible offeror.'
taxonomy_notes.bfa_role: BFA's role is not stated in the RFP (which is a government solicitation document). BFA would be a subconsultant or design subconsultant to one of the MACC holder contractors. BOD .doc is titled as a BFA-authored document (mechanical and electrical BOD revisions), suggesting BFA provided MEP design services. Marked subconsultant as most likely role; flag for human review.
taxonomy_notes.project_status: Project was being procured in July 2021. Given 200-day construction duration and time elapsed since then, project is likely complete. Marked complete; flag for human review.
taxonomy_notes.disciplines: BOD file title explicitly references 'mechanical and electrical' — suggesting BFA's scope was mechanical and electrical engineering. Full scope of BOD unknown due to unreadable file.

socioeconomic_participation.notes: MACC vehicle is explicitly 8(a) set-aside. The MACC holders are 8(a) firms or 8(a) JVs. BFA's set-aside status as subconsultant not determinable from RFP.
